channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: A Quiet ICE Surge That Unfolded ‘Everywhere All at Once’ This Summer
item.description: A review of dozens of incidents caught on camera sheds new light on a largely invisible crackdown.

item.title: NPR: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
item.description: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.

item.title: BBC News: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
item.description: Experts say the hack could leave agents vulnerable to scams, blackmail and targeted attacks.

item.title: The Guardian: Toys are us: the adults swapping scrolling for Lego, remote control cars and sewing
item.description: To escape the stresses and strains of adulting, more people are choosing to rekindle their love for childhood toys, games and pastimes A growing number of adult enthusiasts are rediscovering their love for Lego, helping…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Yemen fighting displaces 71,000 children, worsens malnutrition: UNICEF
item.description: More than a quarter of the nearly 2,900 children screened by UNICEF in recent weeks were acutely malnourished.

item.title: Ars Technica: CDC opens state ordering for COVID-19 vaccines after unexplained delay
item.description: Health department previously blamed delay on "not yet finalized procurement decisions."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Who Killed Paulina Borsook’s Career?
item.description: A quarter-century ago, Borsook published a wildly prophetic, penetrating book about Silicon Valley called Cyberselfish. Then she disappeared.

item.title: WIRED Science: The Ovary Is Surprisingly Active After Menopause. Scientists Are Trying to Figure Out Why
item.description: A growing body of research is putting the ovary in a new light, not as an egg factory with an expiration date, but as an organ that shapes women’s health long after the fertile years have passed.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Trump Administration Is Trying to Get Musk and X Out of a $137 Million EU Fine
item.description: The US government filed an application to support the company’s legal challenge against a fine issued under the bloc’s Digital Services Act, which Trump has described as “overseas extortion.”

item.title: The New Yorker: The Week Republicans Finally Panicked About Trump
item.description: The President’s party, facing a midterm reckoning, is begging for a way out of his Iran-war doom loop.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Dennis Lim Doesn’t Recommend Mainlining 12 Hours of Films a Day
item.description: But the New York Film Festival director sometimes has to in order to finalize the festival’s program.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Is Jemima Kirke Now a Manhattan Girl?
item.description: The longtime Brooklyn resident and her mother bought in a prewar Chelsea co-op.
